approach: The bush seems to be... looking at you.
There's something unusual about this vegetation.
You feel like you're being judged. By shrubbery.
Is that... an eye? No. Just a shadow. Probably.
reveal: You see through the disguise. Clever.
I am older than this desert. I remember when it was sea.
The green one seeks the truth. The truth seeks silence.
My cousins in Uplands send greetings. We are connected. Root and branch.
rumor: The earth remembers all. Even what you forget.
Deep below, something stirs. Not evil. Just... waking.
The barrel that walks has purpose. Ancient purpose.
When the stone weeps, plant there. Life finds a way.
dialog.quest_hook: Seeds I carry. Ancient. Sleeping. Need planting where stone weeps. Find such place. Plant three. Return. Reward: knowledge.
dialog.quest_active: Stone weeps. Water from rock. Three seeds. Three spots. Life returns.
dialog.quest_complete: You planted. Life grows. The desert thanks you. Here. My blessing. Carry it.
dialog.quest_reward: Druid's Blessing - Nature speaks to you

party_reactions.kade: I... see a bush. That's definitely a bush.
party_reactions.nix7: Botanical analysis: anomalous. Recommend: further study.
party_reactions.korr: I sense the ancient power. Respect, elder one.
party_reactions.renna: Arcane signatures detected. This is no mere shrubbery.

stages.hook: Seeds I carry. Ancient. Need planting where stone weeps. Find such place. Plant three. Return.
stages.active: Stone weeps means water from rock. Three locations. Three plantings. Life returns to dead places.
stages.complete: Planted well. Life stirs. Desert remembers green. Take this blessing. Speak with my kind.
